scenarios.name: Battle of Yavin — Destroy the Death Star
scenarios.description: The Rebel Alliance launches a desperate attack on the Imperial Death Star superweapon. Starfighter squadrons must penetrate TIE fighter defenses and fire proton torpedoes into the thermal exhaust port.
scenarios.map: Space combat around the Death Star station

objective.rebel: Destroy the Death Star by firing proton torpedoes into the thermal exhaust port (200-meter targeting post). Requires Force-assisted shot or precise targeting computer.
objective.imperial: Defend the Death Star and destroy all Rebel starfighters. Prevent torpedo strikes on the exhaust port.

rebel_forces: Red Squadron: 4 X-Wings (Luke Skywalker, Biggs, Wedge, Jek)

special_rules: The Death Star's superlaser can be fired once per game, destroying any ship in its path
Han Solo arrives after Round 3 with the Millennium Falcon
Thermal exhaust port requires Range 1 torpedo attack with no defense dice
Darth Vader has superior pilot skill and attacks first in combat phase

victory_conditions.rebel_victory: Death Star destroyed (thermal exhaust port hit with torpedoes)
victory_conditions.imperial_victory: All Rebel starfighters destroyed or Death Star survives 6 rounds

scenarios.name: Battle of Hoth — Defense of Echo Base
scenarios.description: Imperial forces under Darth Vader discover the Rebel Echo Base on the ice planet Hoth. AT-AT walkers advance across the frozen terrain while Rebel snowspeeders and ground forces mount a desperate defense.
scenarios.map: Ice planet terrain with light snow cover, difficult terrain (ice crevasses), and Echo Base trench

objective.rebel: Survive 6 rounds and evacuate Echo Base. Destroy as many AT-ATs as possible to delay the Imperial advance.
objective.imperial: Destroy Echo Base by reaching and overrunning the trench defenses. Eliminate Rebel forces.

rebel_forces: Rebel Artillery Teams: 2 units (Z9 Artillery Pieces)

special_rules: Snowspeeders can use tow-cables to trip AT-ATs, making them vulnerable for 1 round
Artillery has long range but cannot move and fire in the same activation
Echo Base trench provides heavy cover to defending units
Rebels win if they survive 6 rounds (evacuation completes)
Difficult terrain (ice) slows walker movement

victory_conditions.rebel_victory: Survive 6 rounds OR destroy 3+ AT-ATs and evacuate Leia
victory_conditions.imperial_victory: Destroy Echo Base (reach trench with walkers) OR eliminate all Rebel forces

scenarios.name: Battle of Endor — Assault on the Second Death Star
scenarios.description: The Rebel Alliance launches a two-pronged assault: ground forces attack the shield generator on Endor's forest moon while starfighters wait in orbit. Once the shield drops, the fleet attacks the second Death Star.
scenarios.map: Two theaters: Forest moon of Endor (ground) and Space above Endor (orbital)

objective.rebel: Destroy the shield generator on Endor, then destroy the second Death Star in orbit.
objective.imperial: Defend the shield generator and the Death Star. Destroy Rebel forces on both fronts.

rebel_forces: Ground: Ewoks, Rebel Commandos, Speeder Bikes, 2-Wheeled Speeders
Space: Red Squadron (X-Wings), Gold Squadron (Y-Wings), Blue Squadron (X-Wings)
Rebel Fleet: Home One flagship, CR90 Corvettes (arrives after shield drops)
imperial_forces: Ground: Stormtroopers, AT-STs, Shield Generator Tower
Space: TIE Defender Squadron, TIE Fighter Squadrons, Death Star II (partial)

special_rules: Two-theater battle: ground and space phases resolved each round
Shield generator must be destroyed before Rebel fleet can engage
Ewoks are weak individually but powerful in numbers with traps
Death Star II is incomplete — can fire superlaser once to destroy Rebel flagship
Sith duel: Luke Skywalker vs Darth Vader vs Emperor Palpatine resolves separately

victory_conditions.rebel_victory: Destroy shield generator AND Death Star II
victory_conditions.imperial_victory: Destroy Rebel fleet OR hold shield generator for 6 rounds

scenarios.name: Battle of Geonosis — First Battle of the Clone Wars
scenarios.description: Jedi Knights Obi-Wan, Anakin, and Mace Windu are captured in the Petranaki Arena on Geonosis. The Republic launches a rescue mission as the Clone Army makes its debut against the Separatist droid army.
scenarios.map: Petranaki Arena and surrounding Geonosian terrain with construction sites for the Separatist fleet

objective.republic: Rescue the Jedi from the arena and destroy the Separatist fleet under construction.
objective.separatist: Defend the arena, eliminate the Jedi, and protect the droid fleet construction.

republic_forces: Jedi: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu (start in arena)
Clone Trooper Squadrons: 4 units (arrive via Acclamator)

special_rules: Jedi start in the Petranaki Arena and must escape before clones arrive
Clone forces arrive after Round 2 via Acclamator-class transport
Arena is difficult terrain with creature threats (Lampy, Nexu, Catbird)
Count Dooku and Mace Windu duel in the arena (special combat resolution)
Separatist fleet under construction provides bonus points if destroyed

victory_conditions.republic_victory: Rescue all 3 Jedi AND destroy Separatist fleet construction
victory_conditions.separatist_victory: Eliminate all Jedi OR survive 6 rounds with fleet intact

scenarios.name: Battle of Christophsis — Siege of the Republic
scenarios.description: A Separatist blockade traps Republic forces on Christophsis. Obi-Wan and Anakin lead a desperate defense while waiting for reinforcements from the Venator-class fleet.
scenarios.map: Urban terrain with ruined buildings and Republic supply depot

objective.republic: Hold the supply depot until reinforcements arrive (Round 5).
objective.separatist: Capture the supply depot and eliminate Republic forces before reinforcements arrive.

special_rules: Republic reinforcements (Venator fleet) arrive at Round 5
Supply depot provides cover and healing to adjacent Republic units
General Grievous arrives by dropship at Round 3
Urban terrain provides light and heavy cover

victory_conditions.republic_victory: Hold supply depot until Round 5 ends
victory_conditions.separatist_victory: Capture supply depot OR eliminate all Republic forces

scenarios.name: The Kessel Run — Smuggler's Gambit
scenarios.description: Han Solo and Chewbacca pilot the Millennium Falcon through the dangerous Kessel Run, evading Imperial TIE fighters and navigating the Maw Black Hole cluster while delivering cargo for Jabba the Hutt.
scenarios.map: Space combat near Kessel with asteroid fields and the Maw black hole cluster

objective.han_solo: Navigate through the Maw and exit the play area with cargo intact while evading Imperial pursuit.
objective.imperial: Destroy or capture the Millennium Falcon before it escapes through the Maw.

special_rules: Asteroid fields create difficult terrain and block line of sight
The Maw black hole cluster pulls ships inward — ships entering must pass a navigation check
Millennium Falcon has superior speed and can use the 'Coward's Flip' maneuver
Imperial Star Destroyer can fire turbolasers but is slow to target
Han wins if Falcon exits through the Maw zone

victory_conditions.han_victory: Millennium Falcon exits through the Maw with cargo
victory_conditions.imperial_victory: Destroy Millennium Falcon OR hold it for 3 rounds

scenarios.name: Battle of Jakku — Last Stand Against the First Order
scenarios.description: The final confrontation between the Resistance and the First Order on the desert planet Jakku. Rey faces Palpatine while Poe and Finn lead the ground assault against overwhelming First Order forces.
scenarios.map: Desert terrain with wreckage of the Supremas-class Star Destroyer Finalizer

objective.resistance: Destroy First Order transports preventing Palpatine's escape and hold the line.
objective.first_order: Escape with the transports and eliminate Resistance forces.

special_rules: First Order transports must reach the edge of the play area to escape
Rey and Kylo Ren have a Force duel that affects nearby units
Palpatine's presence on the Supremas provides Dark Side buffs to First Order
Wreckage of the Finalizer provides heavy cover
Resistance has orbital X-Wing strike capability

victory_conditions.first_order_victory: Escape with 2+ transports OR eliminate all Resistance forces

scenarios.name: Blockade of Naboo — Liberation of the Royal Planet
scenarios.description: The Trade Federation blockades and invades Naboo. Young Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi seek help from Jedi Master Yoda, while Captain Panaka and the Gungan army fight to liberate their world.
scenarios.map: Space above Naboo (blockade) and Theed Palace grounds (ground)

objective.naboo: Break the Trade Federation blockade and liberate Theed Palace.
objective.trade_federation: Maintain the blockade and hold Theed Palace against the liberation force.

naboo_forces: Jar Jar Binks (Gungan General — special ability)

special_rules: Destroying Droid Control Ships shuts down all battle droids in that theater
Gungan submersible fighters can surprise-attack from below
Theed Palace provides heavy cover
Queen Amidala's surrender is a ruse — Gungan attack begins at Round 3

victory_conditions.naboo_victory: Destroy both Droid Control Ships AND liberate Theed Palace
victory_conditions.trade_federation_victory: Hold Theed Palace for 6 rounds OR destroy all Naboo starfighters

scenarios.name: Battle of Mustafar — Fall of a Jedi
scenarios.description: The Clone Wars end on the lava world of Mustafar. Anakin Skywalker, now Darth Vader, turns on the Republic. Obi-Wan Kenobi pursues him to a final duel on the banks of a lava river.
scenarios.map: Lava river terrain with Separatist flagship and mining facilities

objective.obi_wan: Reach the Separatist flagship and activate the clone trooper chip deactivation code. Survive the duel with Anakin.
objective.darth_vader: Eliminate Obi-Wan and secure the Separatist leadership for the Emperor.

obi_wan_forces: Obi-Wan Kenobi (Jedi Master — starts at landing zone)
Clone Troopers (turn on Vader at Round 3): 2 units
darth_vader_forces: Darth Vader/Anakin Skywalker (Sith Lord — starts at flagship)
Remaining Separatist Droids: 2 units (B1 Battle Droids)

special_rules: Lava terrain: units ending movement adjacent to lava lose 1 wound
Clone troopers switch sides at Round 3 (Obi-Wan's clones turn on Vader)
Final duel: when Obi-Wan and Vader are in the same hex, special duel resolution
Separatist flagship provides cover to Vader
Lightning storm affects both players equally

victory_conditions.obi_wan_victory: Reach flagship AND survive duel with Vader
victory_conditions.vader_victory: Eliminate Obi-Wan OR destroy flagship before Obi-Wan reaches it

scenarios.name: Battle of Starkiller Base — Resistance Against the First Order
scenarios.description: The Resistance launches a desperate mission to destroy Starkiller Base, the First Order's planet-converted superweapon. Poe Dameron leads the bombing run while Finn and Rose infiltrate the shield generator.
scenarios.map: Snow-covered planet surface (ground) and space above Starkiller Base

objective.resistance: Disable the shield generator and destroy Starkiller Base's energy relay.
objective.first_order: Defend the shield generator and energy relay. Destroy Resistance forces before the superlaser fires again.

first_order_forces: TIE Rafier Squadron: 3 units (capable of atmospheric flight)
Starkiller Base Superlaser (fires once per game)

special_rules: Shield generator must be disabled before bombers can reach the energy relay
TIE Rafiers are the only TIEs capable of atmospheric flight
Starkiller Base superlaser can destroy one Resistance ship per game
Holding pattern: Resistance bombers must orbit while waiting for shield to drop
Finn and Rose's ground mission runs parallel to the space battle

victory_conditions.resistance_victory: Destroy the energy relay with torpedoes
victory_conditions.first_order_victory: Destroy all Resistance bombers OR hold for 6 rounds
